info.title: VMEG Open API
info.description: VMEG public Open API for TTS, text translation, media translation, voice cloning, and asset management. Responses use `{ code, message, data }`; `code === 200` means success.

tags.name: Media translation
tags.description: Async video and audio translation tasks

tags.name: Task management
tags.description: List, detail, and delete submitted tasks

tags.name: Assets - Materials
tags.description: CDN direct upload, multipart upload, list, and delete

post.description: Invokes vmeg-tts Lambda (RequestResponse) and returns synthesis results inline.

x-mint.content:
<Note>
**Response:** immediate acceptance (`taskId`, `createdAt`). Does not include synthesis results.

**Callbacks → task.completed:** the [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) **request body** VMEG POSTs to your server when the task finishes. The `data` field below carries synthesis results.
</Note>

200.description: Acceptance only (`taskId`, `createdAt`). Synthesis results are in the webhook callback request body under **Callbacks → task.completed**.

post.description: HTTP **request body** of the POST VMEG sends to your [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) URL when synthesis finishes. Not part of the create-async **Response** above.

</Note>

Async media translation. If request `taskType` is `at` but the material is video, the server may run `vt` instead (see `taskType` in the acceptance response).

parameters.name: projId
parameters.description: Project ID (from API Key auth context)

post.summary: Task completion callback (sent by VMEG to your URL)
post.description: After async tasks complete, VMEG POSTs to your configured webhook URL. Per-task `data` schemas are documented under Callbacks on each `create-async` operation. Envelope signing: Webhooks guide.

IdempotencyKey.name: X-Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key (required on async create, max 64 characters)

provider.description: Engine code: V1-V5, or MM/V2/CB/IT/CVC, etc.

uri.description: Audio URL (CDN HTTPS in API responses; S3 URI from Lambda)

errorMessage.description: Failure reason when synthesis failed for this item

OpenApiTtsCreateData.description: Synchronous create response and task.completed webhook `data` for TTS

results.description: Present on synchronous create and in the task.completed webhook `data`

OpenApiTaskAcceptedData.description: Immediate response for async task submission (no task results)

createdAt.description: Returned by TTS and text translation async create

errorMessage.description: Failure reason when translation failed for this segment

OpenApiTranslateCreateData.description: Synchronous create response and task.completed webhook `data` for text translation

items.description: Aligned with request segments by index; present on synchronous create and in the task.completed webhook `data`

OpenApiCloneVoiceCreateData.description: Synchronous create response and task.completed webhook `data` for voice clone (voiceId and audio populated on completion)

taskType.description: vt = video translation, at = audio translation

options.description: Dubbing, ASR, translation, etc. See media translation guide

OpenApiMediaTranslationAcceptedData.description: Immediate response for media translation async create (no deliverables)

taskType.description: Effective task type (may differ from request when audio material is processed as video translation)

result.description: Sanitized deliverables (CDN URLs and selected fields); structure varies by taskType
Task-specific result; structure varies by taskType

s3Uri.description: Upload target S3 URI from gen-upload-url or multipart initiate

eTag.description: ETag from the S3 part PUT response

uploadUrl.description: Presigned PUT URL; empty when instant upload (dedup) applies

material.description: Present when the file already exists (instant upload)

s3Uri.description: Upload target S3 URI; pass to complete

recommendedPartSize.description: Suggested part size in bytes (S3 multipart minimum is typically 5 MB except the last part)

url.description: Presigned PUT URL for this part

OpenApiCallbackEnvelope.description: Shared fields of the HTTP **request body** VMEG POSTs to your [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) URL on `task.completed`. Configure the URL, signing headers, and retries in the Webhooks guide.

extraData.description: Echo of extraData / memo from the submit request

OpenApiTtsTaskCompletedCallback.description: Complete webhook callback **request body** for TTS `task.completed`. See [Webhooks](/guides/webhooks) for URL configuration and signature verification.

OpenApiTranslateTaskCompletedCallback.description: Complete webhook callback **request body** for text translation `task.completed`. See [Webhooks](/guides/webhooks) for URL configuration and signature verification.

OpenApiCloneVoiceTaskCompletedCallback.description: Complete webhook callback **request body** for voice clone `task.completed`. See [Webhooks](/guides/webhooks) for URL configuration and signature verification.

OpenApiMediaTranslationTaskCompletedCall.description: Complete webhook callback **request body** for media translation `task.completed`. See [Webhooks](/guides/webhooks) for URL configuration and signature verification.

OpenApiCallbackDispatchBody.description: Union of all task.completed payloads (see per-endpoint Callbacks on create-async operations)
